Senior Backend Engineer - Freight Platform

We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own the services that plan and settle multi-drop freight routes for our European operators.

What you will do:
- Own the routing service end to end, from design through to production support
- Work with dispatch operations to turn real-world constraints into software
- Help set the technical direction of the backend team

Required:
- 5+ years building production backend services with Node.js and TypeScript
- Strong PostgreSQL skills, including query tuning and schema design
- Experience designing and operating event-driven systems at scale
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and reviewing their work

Nice to have:
- Bonus points for exposure to Kafka or similar streaming platforms
- Familiarity with the logistics or transport domain is a plus
Backend engineer wanted. Must know Go.

Embedded Software Engineer

Quiet Instruments is hiring an embedded engineer to work on our vibration sensor firmware.

Required:
- 3+ years of embedded C development on ARM Cortex-M
- Experience with real-time signal processing
- Comfortable reading oscilloscope traces and datasheets

Nice to have:
- Exposure to Rust on embedded targets is a plus

Platform Engineer

We need a platform engineer to run our Kubernetes estate.

Required:
- 4+ years operating Kubernetes in production
- Strong Terraform and CI/CD experience
- Experience with on-call and incident response

Nice to have:
- Bonus points for Go

Staff Frontend Engineer

You will lead the front end of our dispatch console, used daily by operators to move freight.

What you will do:
- Set the direction for our React application and its design system
- Work directly with dispatchers to shape the interface around their workflow

Required:
- 7+ years of professional frontend development
- Deep React and TypeScript experience, including performance profiling
- A track record of accessible, keyboard-navigable interfaces
- Experience mentoring other frontend engineers

Nice to have:
- Ideally some experience with mapping or geospatial interfaces
- Familiarity with logistics is a plus
